sentences.zh: 显而易见，电影能够拥有的另一个优势就是与IP产生连接，这也是我们经常使用的一个词。

sentences.en: Intellectual property, franchises, pre-existing, sort of already baked lore or names that, you know, sort of do half the work already to getting people in theaters.
sentences.zh: 知识产权、系列电影、那些预先存在的、可以说是已经根深蒂固的背景设定或知名名称，它们在吸引观众进电影院这件事上已经起到了事半功倍的作用。

sentences.en: Wicked is based on a very long chain of IP.
sentences.zh: 《魔法坏女巫》改编自一条非常漫长的IP链。

sentences.en: It was never called IP back then, but you have a book that came out in 1900.
sentences.zh: 虽然那时候还不叫IP，但你有一本1900年出版的书。

sentences.en: And then you had a movie musical that came out in 1939, still one of the most famous American movies ever made, The Wizard of Oz.
sentences.zh: 然后你有了1939年上映的音乐剧电影《绿野仙踪》，它至今仍是美国历史上最著名的电影之一。

sentences.en: And then you have this book in 1995 by Gregory Maguire.
sentences.zh: 接着是格雷戈里·马奎尔于1995年出版的这本书。

sentences.en: You have this musical in 2003.
sentences.zh: 然后是2003年的这部音乐剧。

sentences.en: And now you have these two movies.
sentences.zh: 现在你又有了这两部电影。

sentences.en: Kyle, I'm wondering how much of the success of these two films you attribute to the fact that this is, you know, at least in America,
sentences.zh: 凯尔，我想知道你认为这两部电影的成功，有多大程度上要归功于这样一个事实，即这（至少在美国）是一个流传了如此之久的经典故事。

sentences.en: like a sort of a story that's been around for so long.
sentences.zh: 这也是其中一部分原因。

sentences.en: And this is a part of it.
sentences.zh: 奥兹国IP？

sentences.en: The OZIP?
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这是一个很有意思的测试案例。

sentences.en: You know, this is an interesting test case.
sentences.zh: 因为很显然，我认为在我们成长的时候，我敢打赌对大多数听众来说，

sentences.en: Because obviously I think that when we grew up, and I would wager most of the listeners, The Wizard of Oz was ubiquitous.
sentences.zh: 《绿野仙踪》是无处不在的。

sentences.en: You would always see it on television.
sentences.zh: 你总能在电视上看到它。

sentences.en: It was, you know, perhaps...
sentences.zh: 它就像是……也许吧……

sentences.en: Every Thanksgiving at Grandma's house.
sentences.zh: 每个感恩节都在奶奶家。

sentences.en: It is a Thanksgiving film.
sentences.zh: 这是一部感恩节电影。

sentences.en: At least once a year for more than 30 years.
sentences.zh: 三十多年来，每年至少看一次。

sentences.en: Certainly felt like one of the top three most famous movies ever made.
sentences.zh: 感觉绝对算是有史以来最著名的三部电影之一。

sentences.en: And probably one of the top three movies most watched.
sentences.zh: 也可能是观看次数最多的前三部电影之一。

sentences.en: You could pretty much count on anybody you met having watched that movie at some point.
sentences.zh: 你几乎可以确信，你遇到的任何人都在某个时候看过那部电影。

sentences.en: I'm not sure that that is true of the generation that is coming up.
sentences.zh: 我不确定现在的年轻一代是不是也这样。

sentences.en: Would a 10-year-old have seen The Wizard of Oz as many times as we would have by 10?
sentences.zh: 一个10岁的小孩看《绿野仙踪》的次数，能赶上我们10岁前看的次数吗？

sentences.en: Or would a 10-year-old have seen it at all?
sentences.zh: 或者说，10岁的小孩根本就没看过？

sentences.en: You know, they're not watching movies that are ubiquitous on TV because they're more prone to watch a Roblox playthrough on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们不看电视上随处可见的电影，因为他们更倾向于在油管上看《罗布乐思》的游戏实况。

sentences.en: So I don't know that...
sentences.zh: 所以我不知道……

sentences.en: You just really depressed me.
sentences.zh: 你刚才真的把我打击到了。

sentences.en: Well, I'm saying that this might be an interesting case of the tail wagging the dog in the future.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这可能是未来出现“尾大不掉”的一个有趣案例。

sentences.en: That people will be coming to The Wizard of Oz predominantly through Wicked.
sentences.zh: 人们主要是通过《魔法坏女巫》来了解《绿野仙踪》的。

sentences.en: And not the other way around.
sentences.zh: 而不是反过来。

sentences.en: And it's going to be particularly interesting because Wicked for Good, the second film, really relies on how well you know The Wizard of Oz.
sentences.zh: 这将特别有趣，因为第二部电影《魔法坏女巫：为了美好》非常依赖于你对《绿野仙踪》的熟悉程度。

sentences.en: Particularly the movie version of that.
sentences.zh: 特别是电影版的《绿野仙踪》。

sentences.en: Because the characters are getting into places a lot is implied.
sentences.zh: 因为角色们去到的很多地方都有着很多的潜台词和暗示。

sentences.en: And I don't know if young kids today are going to get all those references.
sentences.zh: 我不知道现在的年轻孩子能不能看懂所有这些梗。

sentences.en: One thought, just in terms of IP, yellow brick Roblox.
sentences.zh: 我有一个想法，就IP而言，黄砖路的《罗布乐思》。

sentences.en: I think this is the tie-in we've been looking for.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我们一直在寻找的联名款。

sentences.en: I think that's right, but I also think there's a possibility where that makes Wicked for Good more enjoyable to those viewers.
sentences.zh: 我也觉得是这样，但同时我也觉得这可能会让那些观众觉得《魔法坏女巫：为了美好》更有意思。

sentences.en: Because I think if you have read the original book, you've seen the film a gajillion times, and you come to Wicked, the twists at the ending are quite obvious, right?
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得如果你读过原著小说，把这部电影看过无数遍，然后来看《魔法坏女巫》，结尾的反转就相当明显了，对吧？

sentences.en: It's not really a surprise.
sentences.zh: 其实算不上什么惊喜。

sentences.en: You go, oh yeah, we saw that coming a mile away.
sentences.zh: 你会说，哦，是的，我们早就料到会有这一出了。

sentences.en: But if you can't see it coming a mile away, I can imagine the ending of this film would be that much more satisfying if, you know,
sentences.zh: 但如果你猜不到的话，我可以想象这部电影的结局会让人满意得多，如果，你知道的，

sentences.en: scratchy-faced Scarecrow Man comes as a genuine surprise to you.
sentences.zh: 那个满脸稻草的稻草人男士出场时能真正让你感到惊喜的话。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I guess I was surprised that, again, I have listened to the show and I've seen a scratchy bootleg.
sentences.zh: 我想我感到惊讶的是，话说回来，我听过音乐剧，也看过模糊不清的盗录版。

sentences.en: I guess I forgot how much the second act really ties into The Wizard of Oz, which is a film maybe like Kyle, maybe like you.
sentences.zh: 我想我忘了第二幕跟《绿野仙踪》的联系有多紧密，就像凯尔一样，也许你也一样。

sentences.en: I've seen dozens and dozens of times, either in full or in part.
sentences.zh: 我已经看过几十遍了，无论是完整版还是片段。

sentences.en: And I just side note, if you are a parent and you have not shown your child The Wizard of Oz already, shame on you.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，如果你是一个父母，却还没带你的孩子看过《绿野仙踪》，那真是太逊了。

sentences.en: And you should do that immediately.
sentences.zh: 你们应该马上看一遍。

sentences.en: It is one of the great things that this country has ever produced.
sentences.zh: 这是这个国家曾经出品过的最伟大的作品之一。

sentences.en: How did your son react when you showed him?
sentences.zh: 你儿子看完有什么反应？

sentences.en: He loved it.
sentences.zh: 他很喜欢。

sentences.en: Was that post-Wicked?
sentences.zh: 那是看《魔法坏女巫》之后吗？

sentences.en: It was not post-Wicked.
sentences.zh: 不是看完《魔法坏女巫》之后。

sentences.en: I think we showed it to him.
sentences.zh: 我想我们是在那之前给他看的。

sentences.en: Did it scare him?
sentences.zh: 把他吓到了吗？

sentences.en: Yes, there were a couple parts that scared him.
sentences.zh: 是的，有几个片段把他吓坏了。

sentences.en: The kids are going to be okay.
sentences.zh: 孩子们会没事的。

sentences.en: The Wicked Witch of the West in the 1939 musical is scary.
sentences.zh: 1939年音乐剧里的西方邪恶女巫确实挺吓人的。

sentences.en: There are lots of things that are weird about that movie and sort of offbeat.
sentences.zh: 那部电影里有很多奇怪的地方，而且有点非主流。

sentences.en: But it is beautiful and it is something that everyone should experience.
sentences.zh: 但它很美，而且是每个人都应该体验一下的作品。

sentences.en: So please, show your children The Wizard of Oz, either before or after you're going to see this movie.
sentences.zh: 所以，请在去看这部电影之前或之后，带你的孩子看看《绿野仙踪》吧。

sentences.en: This has been a public service announcement.
sentences.zh: 这是一则公益广告。

sentences.en: So Wicked for Good, as we said, it's sort of pitched to be one of the top grossing movies of the year.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所说，《魔法坏女巫：为了美好》有望成为今年票房最高的电影之一。

sentences.en: And Kyle, I'm wondering, what is missing in movies that this movie is providing to viewers, providing in the marketplace?
sentences.zh: 凯尔，我想知道，这部电影给观众、给市场带来了什么目前电影里所缺的东西？

sentences.en: It feels like it's sort of filling a hole that desperately wants to be filled in some way.
sentences.zh: 感觉它填补了一个非常渴望被填补的空白。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, I think there's a really incredible contrast that can be drawn here.
sentences.zh: 是的，我的意思是，我觉得这里可以做一个非常不可思议的对比。

sentences.en: At a time when it's hard to get almost every demographic to the movies, you have one demographic, young girls, who will not just go to the movies, but will go over and over.
sentences.zh: 在几乎很难吸引到任何特定群体去电影院的时期，你却拥有这样一个群体——年轻女孩，她们不仅会去看电影，而且会一遍又一遍地去。

sentences.en: That repeat audience is why Wicked became such a phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 这种回头客效应正是《魔法坏女巫》成为这种现象级作品的原因。

sentences.en: And you can trace that back to movies like Barbie, even all the way back to Titanic.
sentences.zh: 你可以追溯到像《芭比》这样的电影，甚至一直追溯到《泰坦尼克号》。

sentences.en: That if women really like something, as they do with, you know, K-pop Demon Hunters or Wednesday, they will watch it multiple times, they will discuss it with their friends,
sentences.zh: 如果女性真的很喜欢某样东西，就像她们喜欢《韩国流行音乐恶魔猎手》或《星期三》那样，她们就会看好几遍，会和朋友讨论，

sentences.en: now they will make fan edits.
sentences.zh: 现在她们还会制作粉丝剪辑版。

sentences.en: It's, you know, the bounds of their fandom and obsession are ultimately very lucrative in a way where I'm not sure that we actually have enough product coming out to satisfy,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，她们的粉丝群体和痴迷程度最终会带来丰厚的回报，而我不太确定我们是否有足够的产品来满足

sentences.en: you know, probably the most loyal fan base there is, the most loyal demographic.
sentences.zh: 可以说是最忠诚的粉丝群体、最忠诚的受众。

sentences.en: So much of what we're seeing and what we're seeing not work is aimed at either young men or older audiences who simply aren't showing up.
sentences.zh: 我们看到的很多东西以及那些没能成功的东西，都是针对年轻男性或年长观众的，而他们根本就不会买账。

sentences.en: And then you have this slice of the demographic pie where they're not just showing up, they're showing up once, twice, three times, four times and bringing their friends.
sentences.zh: 然后你就有了这块受众蛋糕，她们不仅会来，而且会来一次、两次、三次、四次，还会带上她们的朋友。

sentences.en: So what he's saying is, could you hurry up with Practical Magic 2?
sentences.zh: 所以他想表达的是，能不能快点拍《超异能快感2》？

sentences.en: We're waiting, we're ready, I've got 22 bucks ad nauseum.
sentences.zh: 我们在等，我们准备好了，我已经准备好掏22美元了，没完没了。

sentences.en: Practical Magic 2, you've got Devil Wears Prada 2 coming out, but then also let's make more properties that I think, you know,
sentences.zh: 《超异能快感2》，还有即将上映的《穿普拉达的女王2》，但除此之外，让我们多创作一些作品，我觉得，你知道的，

sentences.en: young women want to feel like they've stumbled upon these things themselves, that they are part of the ground floor in making these things a hit.
sentences.zh: 年轻女性希望觉得这些东西是她们自己无意中发现的，觉得她们是让这些作品大获成功的幕后功臣。

sentences.en: Lady Bird.
sentences.zh: 《伯德小姐》。

sentences.en: I think my mother's ears just perked up about an hour and a half away when she heard you say Practical Magic 2.
sentences.zh: 我想我妈妈在听到你说《超异能快感2》的那一刻，远在九霄云外（指隔得很远）的耳朵都竖起来了。

sentences.en: There's no one who's more excited for this film.
sentences.zh: 没有人比她更期待这部电影了。

sentences.en: Tell her to call me.
sentences.zh: 让她给我打电话。

sentences.en: Madison, I don't know if you would call yourself an Ossian, but you have been part of a subset of this fandom from the beginning before there was ever...
sentences.zh: 麦迪逊，我不知道你会不会称自己为“奥兹迷”，但你从一开始就属于这个粉丝群体的一个分支，甚至在……之前。

sentences.en: I'm just trying not to claim, like, stolen green valor, but I think we've established that I am a long-time fan.
sentences.zh: 我只是尽量不去假装拥有什么“绿色荣誉”，但我想我们已经证实我是个老粉了。

sentences.en: Okay, okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: I don't want to speak for you.
sentences.zh: 我不想替你说话。

sentences.en: You just want to speak for the animals.
sentences.zh: 你只想替动物说话。

sentences.en: No one should speak for the animals.
sentences.zh: 任何人都不应该替动物说话。

sentences.en: What was the...
sentences.zh: 那是什么……

sentences.en: Can you tell us, like, what has the fandom for this been like?
sentences.zh: 你能跟我们讲讲，这个粉丝群体一直以来是什么样的吗？

sentences.en: You know, what was it like back when it was just on Broadway?
sentences.zh: 你知道的，当年它还在百老汇上演的时候是什么样的？

sentences.en: Yeah, Wicked has always been an extremely online musical because if you think about it, Wicked the novel, boil it down, it's fanfic, which is a deeply online genre.
sentences.zh: 是的，《魔法坏女巫》一直是一部极度依赖网络的音乐剧，因为如果你仔细想想，小说版的《魔法坏女巫》归根结底就是同人小说，这是一个非常网络化的流派。

sentences.en: And it's also quite obviously a story about being othered,
sentences.zh: 而且它显然也是一个关于“边缘化”的故事，

sentences.en: whether that's as a queer person or a person of color or really anyone who has any experience of feeling not part of the in-group can watch the show and really connect to it.
sentences.zh: 无论是作为酷儿群体、有色人种，还是任何有过不属于主流群体体验的人，看这部剧时都能产生强烈的共鸣。

sentences.en: And those are the communities that historically congregate in online spaces, right?
sentences.zh: 而这些正是历史上喜欢聚集在网络空间的群体，对吧？

sentences.en: And that's chat rooms, forums, boards.
sentences.zh: 也就是聊天室、论坛、讨论区。

sentences.en: So it makes perfect sense to me that the groups of people with whom this show resonates, present company included,
sentences.zh: 所以在我看来，那些对这部剧产生共鸣的人群（包括在座的各位），

sentences.en: then found themselves looking for the community who was also feeling that resonance, and we found it online.
sentences.zh: 自然会去寻找同样有这种共鸣的社区，然后我们在网上找到了彼此。

sentences.en: Broadway, also for many, is an online experience.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说，百老汇也是一种网络体验。

sentences.en: If you don't live here, if you can't afford to see an exorbitantly expensive show, that leaves you with the internet.
sentences.zh: 如果你不住在这里，如果你负担不起票价极其昂贵的演出，留给你的就只有互联网了。

sentences.en: You said you watched a scratchy bootleg.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说你看过模糊的盗录版。

sentences.en: A lot of people experience Broadway online through, and I'm not suggesting anyone film a Broadway show while they're sitting in it.
sentences.zh: 很多人是通过网络来体验百老汇的——我并不是建议任何人坐在剧院里偷偷拍摄百老汇演出。

sentences.en: Do not do that.
sentences.zh: 千万别这么做。

sentences.en: Do not do that.
sentences.zh: 千万别这么做。

sentences.en: It's rude.
sentences.zh: 这很不礼貌。

sentences.en: But people have and people do.
sentences.zh: 但过去有人这么做，现在也依然有人这么做。

sentences.en: And so for many fans of this show, getting to see it only happens through a camera that was snuck into a theater and then uploaded to YouTube.
sentences.zh: 所以对于这部剧的许多粉丝来说，能看到它全靠偷偷带进剧院并上传到油管的摄像机。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I am still new to this world.
sentences.zh: 我对这个世界还很陌生。

sentences.en: So what are some of the ways in which fans, like, sort of engage with each other over Wicked?
sentences.zh: 那么，粉丝们围绕《魔法坏女巫》进行交流的方式有哪些呢？

sentences.en: I mean, some of my favorite Wicked rabbit holes are their entire compilations online of nights where the flying mechanism didn't work.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我最喜欢的《魔法坏女巫》网络深坑之一就是网上那些关于威亚机械故障之夜的各种合集。

sentences.en: No fly nights where Elphaba doesn't get off the ground.
sentences.zh: 艾尔法巴飞不起来的“禁飞之夜”。

sentences.en: And so you've just kind of got, you know, Idina Menzel or whoever's standing in the middle of the stage at the Gershwin holding a broom on the ground, getting louder and louder,
sentences.zh: 所以你就会看到，伊迪娜·门泽尔或者其他任何人在格世温剧院舞台中央拿着一把扫帚站在地上，声音越来越大，

sentences.en: but not going up.
sentences.zh: 但就是飞不上去。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 哦，不。

sentences.en: And then there's also my favorite compilations are people who are hyper-analytical about the riffs in the show.
sentences.zh: 然后还有我最喜欢的合集，就是那些对剧中即兴演唱（riff）进行超强分析的人。

sentences.en: So, like, the incredibly small differences between how actresses who have played these roles sing them.
sentences.zh: 比如，演过这些角色的女演员们在演唱时那些极其微小的差异。

sentences.en: People get very obsessive about who their favorites are, being able to identify them within one note.
sentences.zh: 人们对谁是自己最爱的人有着极其痴迷的狂热，甚至能在一个音符之内认出他们。

sentences.en: It's an incredibly fun game online.
sentences.zh: 这是网上一个极其有趣的游戏。

sentences.en: I highly recommend if you haven't spent some time in this corner of the internet.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没在这个互联网角落消磨过时间，我强烈推荐你去看看。

sentences.en: I'll do that over Thanksgiving.
sentences.zh: 我打算在感恩节期间看。

sentences.en: We don't have anything this year approaching holding space, but, you know, still, once again, this has been a press tour, a marketing cycle that has been pretty intense.
sentences.zh: 今年我们没有什么接近“保持空间”的东西，但无论如何，这又是一次相当密集的宣传巡演、营销周期。
